senses.gloss: m. (compound of מָא, דִּ־, a. ל) belonging, property.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 6:6:4">Y. Keth. VI, 30ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ר׳ … אתפקיד גביה מדל דיתמין</he> orphan’s money was given in trust of R …; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 5:3:6">Y. Gitt. V, 46ᵈ</cite> bot. (insert <he>גביה</he>); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 4:2:6">Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ</cite> bot.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:4:4">Y. Ned. IX, 41ᶜ</cite> <he>הוא ומִדְלֵיה</he> himself and whatever belonged to him.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> beg. <he>ואפקד בידיה מְדִילֵיה</he> and gave him his belongings in charge.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib.</cite> end <he>כל עותרא ומ׳ הדין</he> all these riches and belongings.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>דחלית דלא יסבון מדלי וכ׳</he> (read <he>מדליה</he>) I was afraid lest his relatives may take away his belongings; a. e.—V. <cite ref="M00413"><he>מוֹדְלָא</he></cite>.
